text:
Thanks for checking before you sign up! 🌿

If you've already used the free Standard shipping, you would no longer qualify for the full refund. The refund only applies if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any benefits.

In that case:
- There would be no refund of the $59.
- Your membership benefits would keep going until the end of your paid year, so you'd still get free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, the 90-day guarantee, 10% member pricing on pots and accessories, and early access to rare plant drops.

If you think a special circumstance might apply, I can't promise an exception, but I'm happy to escalate it to a Support Lead to review.

If you want to keep your refund option open, hold off on using any perks until you're sure. Is there anything else I can help with? Happy planting! 🌱
